text: 祥源文旅：因实际控制人俞发祥个人涉嫌信息披露违法违规，中国证监会根据《中华人民共和国证券法》《中华人民共和国行政处罚法》等法律法规，决定对其立案
text_en: Xiangyuan Cultural Tourism: Because actual controller Yu Faxiang is personally suspected of information disclosure violations, the CSRC has decided to open an investigation in accordance with the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China, the Administrative Penalty Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws and regulations
